causes.label: demand
causes.quote: These hot conditions led to high demand for electricity in both states, with Queensland reaching near record levels.

causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: Liddell unit 3 tripped at around 7.30 am reducing capacity by 480 MW, Liddell 2 reduced 100 MW due to a steam leak at around 1.15 pm, Liddell unit 4 reduced 130 MW at 4.30 pm due to a tube leak

causes.label: scheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: Around half of the total capacity unavailable was not offered into the market from the first forecast price published at 12.30 pm the previous day which showed prices above $13 400/MWh for 5 pm.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: A different system normal constraint actually bound for most of the period during which prices were greater than $5000/MWh and limited imports into New South Wales from Victoria to between 341 MW and 289 MW for the 4.30 pm and 5 pm trading intervals.

constraints_named.quote: N^^N_NIL_1 limits northerly flow across the Snowy Mountain region to maintain voltage stability.
N>>N-NIL__B_15M is designed to avoid overloading Upper Tumut to Canberra line on the loss of the Lower Tumut to Canberra line and uses 15 minute line ratings for greater accuracy of the lines limits.

interconnectors_named.name: Vic-NSW
interconnectors_named.quote: As we are treating Queensland and New South Wales as a single region for the purpose of this report, the Victoria to New South Wales interconnector (Vic-NSW) is the critical link to the rest of the NEM.

interconnectors_named.name: QNI
interconnectors_named.quote: Queensland to New South Wales interconnector (QNI) was not constrained for all but two dispatch intervals

intervals.quote: Spot prices in New South Wales and Queensland were aligned and exceeded $5000/MWh for the 4.30 pm and 5 pm trading intervals.

rebid_set_price.quote: Rebidding of capacity by generators during the day from low to high prices (which can put upward pressure on prices), did not contribute to the spot price exceeding $5000/MWh on this occasion.
